learning: Track width at y 0.08 with kp 4.0 rose monotonically to 0.16 (661.5), then fell at 0.17 (651.1) as s-bend exits rose. Slalom remains 0/20 at every geometry, so the damping test covers the untested controller lever.
notes: Iteration 10 package: Builder's wheel_track 0.16 revert with kd raised from 0.5 to 0.8. Only the damping differs from iteration 8 (661.5), so the race isolates kd.
rationale: Iteration 9 (wheel_track 0.17) scored 651.1, below the 661.5 of iteration 8 at 0.16, and its s-bend had 2 off-track exits. The Builder has reverted to wheel_track 0.16 with every other geometry field at iteration 8 values, so this package uses that geometry. The Builder asks for kd 0.8 to test whether damping helps the s-bend or the slalom. Iteration 8 showed s-bend oscillation of 0.29 and oval oscillation of 0.21, both well under the 0.4 gate, so the margin supports a damping test. The controller is otherwise unchanged: kp 4.0, ki 0.1, base_speed 1.6, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], last_direction. Expected: a small gain or no change on the s-bend. I make no claim about the result. Slalom has been 0/20 at every geometry tested, so the race will also report its line_loss and off-track count.
